title: ReturnStatusChanged
description: Event: the status of a return has changed. Sent by the producer to the exchange 'returns.status' with the routing key 'return.status.<newStatus>'. Consumers (Java and PHP) validate against this file. Unknown extra fields are allowed (tolerant reader), so the event can be extended without breaking old consumers.

schemaVersion.description: Optional, reserved for future changes of this schema. Missing means version 1.

eventId.description: Unique id of this event. Consumers use it to detect duplicates (idempotent receiver).

returnId.description: The return this event is about, e.g. RET-2026-00457.

source.description: The system that sent the event.
